body.text: 区域电厂的直接 CO₂ 年平均排放率，以年净发电量为分母。
逐小时记录发电、需求与区际交换的平均功率（MW），乘一小时得到电量（MWh）；时标为小时结束。
在 2023 年 TE 的既有机组关系下，改变终端用电时，模型估计怎样的运行响应。
需求扰动允许运行和容量一起变化时，模型估计怎样的长期响应。本例取 2025 模拟年。

assessment.provenance: Actual normal producer/exporter ran from a private file-copy fixture with read-only source Git identity and optional locks disabled, with before/after HEAD2e69 verification. Only the unsigned107 admission was temporarily opened for capture; earlier source/DOM/case guards remained. Temporary fixture admissions/envelopes never supplied this primary editorial acceptance. The actual capture is honestly dirty working-preview.
assessment.reconstruction: The preceding actual MDX and registry bytes and removal of exactly three new case files reconstruct178 raw files plus the original catalog/literature/readings before105→102→99→95→93. Hash-only old maps and current JSON in old receipts fail. The original source/evidence identities and case semantics remain intact.
assessment.pairedCapture: Primary and independent reviewers rehashed all468 current manifest members and19 selected raw files. Six route-qualified article fingerprints and four public HTML fingerprints were independently produced from the same raw capture and bound with raw digests, lengths, manifest, commit and dirty status. Swapping two print routes or inserting unsupported claims text and regenerating newest report/unit pins now fails both receipt and full ordinary-output gates.
assessment.cases: Both new input/evaluation bytes are independently reconstructed with actual producer identity. The107-active retained B12 power-case check also rejects a wrong producer SHA, input binding or noncanonical input bytes. The other17 older-case producer headers were actually checked in this captured export; this change does not claim a new universal runtime header guard for every older case.
assessment.history: Actual predecessor140 and current166 native B12 addresses retain original scopes. Table cells and exact native P/TABLE destinations, ReaderSection, ordinary explanation and note identities are separately checked; coordinated article rehashing cannot make a hidden table a valid historical destination. Earlier ordinary targets consume only the qualified predecessor projection.
assessment.browser: First actual keyboard testing found that a DOM-visible table target landed behind a fixed header. Only107 versioned P/TABLE targets now have7rem scroll margin. A separate real export was captured after that renderer fix. Primary rerun:20 responsive observations at390/1440/1633/2048/2560 light/dark web/print, no overflow;8 no-script historical controls reached18 ordinary and8 note links, including four table activations. First TH/TD center hit-tests and bounds proved readable tables at roughly112px below97px/56px headers. Four versioned input/result downloads matched bytes; old power input, search, guide and print70 notes passed. Primary inspected actual mobile table/core and print screenshots.
assessment.testsAndLimits: Independent strict private replay and full541-test run passed, plus primary seven focused model/publication tests. These technical results do not replace this real review. Subsequent ordinary clean build, final full tests/types/Docpact, requiredCI, source merge, hostedMain and root integration remain separate. No human, empirical or whole-book approval is claimed.
